description: This Java source file defines the NotificationHelper class, which provides methods to interact with notification-related APIs in the Fineract project. It includes functions to retrieve notifications, check their availability, and wait until notifications are available during tests.

classes.name: NotificationHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to interact with notifications in integration tests, including fetching notifications, checking their availability, and waiting asynchronously until notifications are available.

methods.name: getNotifications
methods.description: Fetches a list of notifications via an API call and returns the response parsed as GetNotificationsResponse.

methods.name: areNotificationsAvailable
methods.description: Checks whether there are any notifications currently available.

methods.name: waitUntilNotificationsAreAvailable
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for notifications to become available, polling periodically with a maximum timeout.
